name: lib-docs
description: Library documentation lookup via DevDocs docsets (836 libraries, zero-key). Resolves a library name to its docset, searches the index, and can fetch excerpts or full pages from cached db.json — a Context7-style 'current docs' source.
use_when: needing current library API docs instead of stale memory

args.name: libraries [filter]
args.description: List available docsets (name, slug, version, alias).

args.name: docs <lib> [query] [--max N] [--excerpt]
args.description: Ranked index entries; --excerpt adds text from db.json.

args.name: page <lib> <path>
args.description: Full text of a doc page (paths from 'docs').

env.AGENT_TOOLS_HOME: State root; docset caches live in <root>/lib-docs/.

stdout: JSON entry lists; raw page text on 'page'.
notes: docs.json cached 24h; db.json revalidated per docset mtime.
